citation.authors: Erinfolami A, Eegunranti A, Ogunsemi O, Oguntuase A et al

cited_by.title: Kola nut: caffeine, the heart and health claims

record.population: 385 randomly chosen secondary school students in Osogbo, Nigeria
record.design: Cross-sectional questionnaire survey of kola nut use
record.finding: Kola nut use was common: 11.2% in the past 30 days, 29.1% in the past year and 74.8% over a lifetime, most starting at 14 or younger. Use was associated with younger age and poor school attendance. The authors suggest awareness programmes about dangers.
record.note: Measures how common chewing is and what it travels with; it tests no health effect, and the 'dangers' wording is the authors' view.
